head: 91a0b4453fcd8a7edc2c1aacab1b8d13900bdf96
claim: an app can add a second Claude Code account that signs in at its own native folder, is listed and checked through a durable binding, keeps its row when a re-auth is cancelled, and is logged out alone on removal

steps.start: Fake gateway, empty account index; deterministic native subprocess fixtures; no real credentials
steps: Add two anthropic-cli accounts in place, each signed in at its own native folder
List both through their bindings; the engine seals and activates nothing
Cancel a re-auth of B; B keeps its binding and folder
Sign B out in its own folder; B reads signed out, A stays ready
Remove B; only B folder is logged out and dropped
steps.result: PASS: durable native binding, list/status/re-auth/logout through it; no engine backend, principal dedup, keyring or live-account claim
